d: Former Pakistani Prime Minister, Imran Khan says he fears he may not walk out of prison alive. He claims he has lost 85% of the vision in his right eye and warns that his health is deteriorating. While the government insists he is receiving proper medical care, his family and the PTI are demanding answers. His sisters have been detained, protests have erupted outside prison, and the political standoff continues. Is Imran Khan's health becoming another battleground in Pakistan's power struggle? Palki Sharma explains.
